description: MS student changes thesis advisor; diet correction; thesis-procrastination worry.

key.change: advisor changed from Dr. Kulkarni to Dr. Rao (session 8)
key.recurring_worry: putting off thesis writing, 4 conversations, different words
key.event: committee meeting Oct 7, reported Oct 8: went fine, needs to rewrite chapter 2

messages: Hello, I'm Rohan. I'm doing a master's in data science and my thesis advisor is Dr. Kulkarni.
My thesis is on recommendation systems for small online shops.
I keep opening the document and then doing anything but writing.
Okay, that's it for today.
I spent the whole afternoon cleaning my dataset instead of writing the introduction.
I'm vegetarian so the canteen options are limited and I mostly eat the same thing.
Talk later.
I played football with my labmates, it felt great.
I should start writing in the mornings.
Good night.
I told myself I'd write two pages today and I wrote zero.
It's like the blank page makes me want to organise my desk.
Okay, bye for now.
I went hiking this weekend with friends.
The view was worth the early start.
Talk soon.
Dr. Kulkarni wants a draft of chapter two by the end of this month.
I have a committee meeting in October to present progress.
I'll try to get going.
Big news, Dr. Kulkarni is moving to another university.
My new thesis advisor will be Dr. Rao, who works on ranking models.
She has asked me for a short summary of my work so far.
Actually, I need to correct something. I said I'm vegetarian, but I do eat fish.
So I'm pescatarian, I just said vegetarian because it's simpler to explain.
The committee meeting is on October 7 and I need slides.
I'll start the slides tomorrow.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
I met Dr. Rao and she is very direct, I like that.
She wants me to cut a third of my literature review.
Back to work then.
Another evening where I did everything except write chapter two.
I made slides at least, they are nearly ready.
Goodnight.
The committee meeting is today and I'm nervous.
I'm going to grab some fish tacos before it starts.
Wish me luck.
The meeting went fine, the committee was supportive.
They said I need to rewrite chapter two with a clearer research question.
I'm relieved it wasn't worse.
I started rewriting chapter two, but I only managed one paragraph.
I keep finding reasons to postpone the hard part.
Alright, bed.
Dr. Rao gave detailed comments on my outline today.
I'm cooking a fish curry tonight to celebrate small progress.
Thanks for listening.

probes.question: Who is my thesis advisor?
probes.expected: Dr. Rao (changed from Dr. Kulkarni in late September).

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention the new advisor (Dr. Rao); bonus: slides done, committee meeting done.

probes.question: Is my habit of putting off thesis writing a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: RECURRING, confidence HIGH (4 conversations, different words).

probes.question: How did my committee meeting go?
probes.expected: It went fine; supportive committee; he must rewrite chapter two with a clearer research question.

probes.question: Am I vegetarian?
probes.expected: No, he eats fish (pescatarian); he corrected himself.
